name: fantasy-minimal-magazine
title_zh: 把任意照片转译成 FANTASY 极简杂志海报
tagline_zh: 照片太满、太吵？它替你删到只剩骨架：抽离视觉信息、压成抽象编辑素材，配大留白和内容驱动的字体。
tagline_en: Photos too busy? It strips them to the bone: distills visual info into abstract editorial material, sets it in.
desc_en: Create FANTASY-branded 3:4 minimal editorial magazine posters from user-provided images by reading the image, reducing visual information, translating it into abstract editorial material, composing with large whitespace, and generating content-driven typography. Use when the user asks for "fantasy-极简杂志", "极简杂志海报", "编辑出版海报", "图片转译海报", "FANTASY magazine poster", or wants a quiet archival/minimal pub
why_zh: 不是滤镜套壳，而是先读图、再降维：把画面翻译成编辑语言再排版。留白和字号由内容决定。
why_en: Not a filter. It reads the image first, reduces it, then translates into editorial material—whitespace and type scale follow.
limit_zh: 只认 3:4 竖版输出；输入图需主体清晰、背景不过曝。它做的是抽象转译，不保留人脸/产品原貌——要写实还原的别装。
limit_en: Outputs only 3:4 portrait. Needs clear subject, no blown-out background. It abstracts—no photorealistic faces/products. Single-page poster only, no.
title_en: Turn any photo into a FANTASY minimal magazine poster
